samples.question: On the left is a 4 by 4 grid of square cells. Each cell starts either dark blue (filled) or light grey (empty), exactly as drawn. One cell is marked by a red ring: the marked cell is the cell whose centre is nearest to the centre of that red ring. On the right is a row of cream cards. Each card carries a small 4 by 4 diagram laid out the same way as the big grid, its top row matching the big grid's top row and its left column matching the big grid's left column, and in each card exactly one whole row or one whole column of that small diagram is coloured. A green line means: fill every cell of the corresponding row or column of the big grid, so each of those cells becomes dark blue whatever it was before. A magenta line means: flip every cell of that row or column, so each dark cell becomes light and each light cell becomes dark. The cards are applied to the big grid one at a time, in order from left to right, as the arrow below them shows. Cards whose line is a different row or column leave the marked cell unchanged. The grid after the cards have been applied is not drawn anywhere. After every card has been applied in order, is the marked cell dark blue or light grey? Answer with one word: filled or empty.
